steps.description: Amend docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md: insert step 3.6 (rehydrate completed-stage artifacts before dispatch loop; absent artifact causes exit 1; ordering constraint: not to be combined with dispatch-loop changes) and add enforcing test names (resume-rehydrate-test.sh, resume-entry-points-test.sh) inline

Amend docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6: add boundary note that resume (same run, ADR-006) is distinct from new-run reuse (ADR-050 §6 governs); update §6's Enforced by entry to also cite resume-rehydrate-test.sh (DSFRSH-2 for the new-run side) and resume-entry-points-test.sh (DSENTR-1 for the resume side) alongside the existing resume-default-test.sh R5–R11 citation
Add _artifact_persist_put_back <from> <to> to core/state/artifact-persist.sh (no-clobber copy skipping stage-io/); body identical to current _hydrate_put_back
Redirect plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh `hydrate_run` call site (the `_hydrate_put_back` call inside `hydrate_run`) to `_artifact_persist_put_back` (hydrate already sources artifact-persist.sh)

Update tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh: add [#1805/DSDLGT-1] section that overrides _artifact_persist_put_back with a sentinel-writing function, runs hydrate_run, and asserts the sentinel was written — fails when plugin reverted to inline _hydrate_put_back

Confirm _cycle_orchestrator_run_body in core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh: the `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard (wrapping `_persisted_iter` read; consuming flag immediately with `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false`; else branch sets `_start_iter=1`) is already in place — verify it is present and correct

In runner.sh, confirm `export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` is present inside `main()`, immediately after the `_runner_resume_rehydrate` call; do NOT set it for fresh runs; remove any unconditional `_cd_iter > 0` stage.start guard from `_cycle_dispatch()` if the branch added one — it was added in error (issue-acceptance finding 2, Gap 7); stage.start for the interrupted cycle member during resume flows from the DSCMBR-1 `resume_first_iter=true` path (see step below), not from an unconditional iter guard

In runner.sh, restore the `--from-stage` validation guard (Gap 12) to execute BEFORE the auto-resume elif block: the guard `if [[ -n "$from_stage" ]] && ! $resume_mode; then error "--from-stage is only valid with --resume"; …; return 1; fi` must appear immediately after argument parsing, before `if $resume_mode; then` and before the `elif ! $no_resume && [[ -f "$state_file" ]]` auto-resume check; this restores the guard to its base-code position so explicit --resume is required even when auto-resume would otherwise activate

In the auto-resume elif branch inside `main()` in runner.sh, extend state discovery: when `$state_dir/pipeline-state.json` does not exist and `$state_dir/latest` is a symlink to a directory containing `pipeline-state.json`, use `$state_dir/latest/pipeline-state.json` as the candidate state file; when `auto_resume` recommendation fires via this path, update state_dir to the resolved per-run directory (via readlink -f) and state_file to `$state_dir/pipeline-state.json`; ensures auto-resume works for the per-run default layout (ADR-059 §1) without requiring ZBUILD_STATE_FILE

Update tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh: add [#1805/DSENTR-2] sub-case that sets ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT to a temp directory, creates `$ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT/runs/<run_id>/pipeline-state.json` with status=interrupted and intake=complete, creates a `$ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT/latest` symlink pointing to that dir, invokes the runner with ZBUILD_STATE_FILE and ZBUILD_STATE_DIR unset, and asserts: pipeline.resume event emitted (auto-resume fired), completed-stage artifacts restored, no stage.start for intake. CRITICAL: the sub-case must NOT set ZBUILD_STATE_FILE or ZBUILD_STATE_DIR in the test environment — these must be absent/unset so the auto-resume symlink guard `[[ -z "${ZBUILD_STATE_FILE:-}" && -L "$state_dir/latest" ]]` can fire; if ZBUILD_STATE_FILE is set the guard is false and the new code path is dead (issue-acceptance finding 1)

Verify (and revert if changed by the branch) tests/golden/full-pipeline/event-sequence.golden and tests/golden/parity/event-sequence.golden: these files encode the pre-branch fresh-run event sequence; if the branch added stage.start events for cycle members in fresh runs (from the erroneous `_cd_iter > 0` guard), those additions must be reverted so the golden files match the restored behavior

Update tests/integration/cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh: (1) update iteration count assertions after the DSITER-1 fix in cycle-orchestrator.sh; (2) do NOT add stage.start count assertions for cycle members in fresh runs — the erroneous `_cd_iter > 0` guard is removed (issue-acceptance finding 2), so fresh-run cycle members must not emit extra stage.start events; if such assertions were added to this test, remove them; (3) also confirm cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, nested-loop-rounds-test.sh, and nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh pass after the cycle-orchestrator DSITER-1 guard fix

Update tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh: (1) add `export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` immediately before the cycle_orchestrator_run call so the [#1805/DSITER-1] assertion "first dispatched iter is 2" reaches the guard; (2) add [#1805/DSCMBR-1] sub-case with a fixture where iter 1 fully completed and iter 2 ran build (complete) then was interrupted before test; set up persisted state accordingly; invoke the runner with --resume; assert no stage.start event for "build" in iter 2 and a stage.start event for "test" in iter 2

In `_cycle_dispatch()` in runner.sh and in `_cycle_orchestrator_run_body()` in cycle-orchestrator.sh, add the skip-on-complete guard for the first resumed iteration: the cycle orchestrator passes `resume_first_iter=true` only when dispatching members of `_start_iter` during a resume (i.e., `_start_iter > 1` and current iter == `_start_iter`); `_cycle_dispatch` with `resume_first_iter=true`: (a) for members already marked complete in persisted state: skip — no stage.start, no dispatch; (b) for the non-complete (interrupted) member: explicitly emit `stage.start` for that member's stage id, then dispatch normally. For `resume_first_iter=false` or not set (fresh runs and later resumed iterations): no stage.start is emitted for cycle members through this code path (pre-branch behavior preserved, golden files intact) — this is the DSCMBR-1 fix (Gap 9)

Update tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh: (1) fix grep-c anti-pattern sites — replace with wc -l; (2) add --no-resume flag to the fresh-run sub-case; (3) remove any stale cycled-dispatch assert_gt block that expected stage.start for all cycle members in fresh runs (the `_cd_iter > 0` guard is removed); (4) add [#1805/DSFRSH-1] assertion in the --no-resume sub-case verifying all stages dispatched from stage 1 with no stage.skip events emitted; (5) add [#1805/DSDSPK-1] assertion in the resume sub-case verifying the interrupted cycle member (the non-complete one) emits stage.start — this is provided by the DSCMBR-1 `resume_first_iter=true` path; (6) add [#1805/DSFRSH-2] assertion in a sub-case with prior run state present and no --resume flag, verifying no stages are skipped due to prior run output; (7) add [#1805/DSSKIP-1] assertion in the resume sub-case verifying no stage.start for a stage already marked complete whose artifact is present after rehydration

Update tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh: (1) fix DSFSTG-1 zero-count grep-c with wc -l; (2) change DSFSTG-2 assert_contains to check for "has no restorable primary artifact"; (3) add [#1805/DSFSTG-3] sub-case: use a 3-unit fixture [intake (leaf), cyc (cycle), verify (leaf)]; set up persisted state with all three stages marked complete in an interrupted run; invoke the runner with explicit --resume and --from-stage cyc; assert that stage.start (or cycle.start) is emitted for cyc AND that stage.start is emitted for verify — both after the skip_until_stage clear — confirming the resume skip guard does not suppress verify even though it was marked complete; this assertion fails on old code (verify is skipped) and passes after the Gap 11 fix (resume_mode=false clears the guard); (4) add [#1805/DSFSTG-4] sub-case: set up an interrupted-state file, invoke with --from-stage without --resume, assert exit 1 and "--from-stage is only valid with --resume" on stderr and no pipeline.resume event
Verify tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh: three entry-path assertions tagged [#1805/DSENTR-1]
Verify tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh: intake's primary artifact pre-written to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the --resume run

Verify tests/integration/resume-after-sigint-test.sh: mock_plugin_factory "intake" writes intake-result.json; runner snapshots it after Phase 1; resume rehydration restores it; P2.T1 (rc=0) still passes with DSRHYD-2 fail-closed in effect
Run npm test and confirm full suite green
